audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was Fiora, First item was Skill and 2+ items was Fiora, all three against the packet chart and the page's own whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6].
audit.why: whys[4] itself calls the level-6 window 'real but conditional' on parrying the stun — that is Skill, not Fiora. whys[5] says the duel 'tilts his way' and whys[6] and late both hand the late game to Tahm.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Skill, First item -> Tahm Kench, 2+ items -> Tahm Kench, with phases[4], [5] and [6] whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks Abyssal Dive as the matchup-defining cooldown but never says what it does mechanically, while the actual defining cast — the 3-stack Tongue Lash — carries no cooldown number.
audit.why: Riot text: Abyssal Dive 'Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area' — a knock-up, therefore an immobilizing effect Riposte converts into a stun, on 21/20/19/18/17s. Tongue Lash only stuns at 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste and is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, so his stun threat comes back far faster than your 24/22/20/18/16s Riposte.
audit.corrected: Track Tongue Lash's 3-stack version (5s at rank 5) as the parry target; Abyssal Dive is a 17s knock-up that also returns a stun if parried.

audit.why: The mirror's warning about a wrong Riposte cooldown ('roughly 14 seconds') does not appear on this page; the Fiora side never states a Riposte cooldown at all. suspectNames flags 'Stack An Acquired Taste' in wants.foe[0], but that is the correct passive name — a false positive.
